rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill. It has front matter and sits under `assets/skills`, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.workflow`. The requirement says the skill must open with its workflow as ordered steps, before any other section.

- **First section:** After the front matter, the file has the `# Habeas requirements` title and a two-sentence preamble. The preamble says every observable result must follow from an agreed requirement and points to the habeas skill. It is not a section. The first section heading is `## Workflow`.
- **Later sections:** `## Writing chapters`, `## Choosing references`, `## What the review checks` and `## Gotchas` all come after `## Workflow`.
- **Ordered steps:** `## Workflow` is a checklist numbered 1 to 7 (`- [ ] 1.` through `- [ ] 7.`). The steps run in sequence: check the starting point, draft, review, present, commit, implement and test, then author evidence.

No violation matches were listed. The site meets the obligation.
